question: What is the meaning of photochemical ozone in relation to essential environmental characteristics?
description: Photochemical ozone refers to the formation of ozone in the atmosphere through chemical reactions involving sunlight and pollutants such as nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds. This is an essential environmental characteristic related to climate change effects, as it contributes to ground-level ozone formation, which can harm human health and ecosystems. It is one of the predetermined environmental essential characteristics listed in the harmonised technical specifications and European assessment documents for sustainable products.
